notes: The verifier performs deterministic structural checks on TypeScript source files without invoking tsc or other build tools.
Interface and type extraction uses balanced brace parsing to reliably identify field definitions.
Required payload fields are verified for presence and snake_case naming; type completeness checks are partial due to reliance on extracted AST fragments rather than full type checking.
Runtime behavior (valid Unix timestamp generation, payload conformance) cannot be verified without execution.

The verifier allows flexible type definition styles (DashboardViewedPayload, QuestionSavedPayload, etc.) as the task does not mandate specific type names beyond requirement for 'TypeScript type definitions for each event payload'.
